## Description {#details}

<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/scheduledagsdnodes">ScheduleDAGSDNodes</a> - A <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/scheduledag">ScheduleDAG</a> for scheduling SDNode-based DAGs.</p>


<p>Edges between SUnits are initially based on edges in the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/selectiondag">SelectionDAG</a>, and additional edges can be added by the schedulers as heuristics. SDNodes such as Constants, Registers, and a few others that are not interesting to schedulers are not allocated SUnits.</p>


<p>SDNodes with MVT::Glue operands are grouped along with the flagged nodes into a single <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/sunit">SUnit</a> so that they are scheduled together.</p>


<p>SDNode-based scheduling graphs do not use <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/sdep/#a07333f8ba53e0454b7ec6365860c0732abe9561936346ab5c5e22fe544994b06e">SDep::Anti</a> or <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/sdep/#a07333f8ba53e0454b7ec6365860c0732a011a1d87822a7f70efee9e430a7ccc36">SDep::Output</a> edges. Physical register dependence information is not carried in the DAG and must be handled explicitly by schedulers.</p>


<p>Definition at line 46 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/codegen/lib/codegen/selectiondag/scheduledagsdnodes-h">ScheduleDAGSDNodes.h</a>.</p>

<p>This function finds loads of the same base and different offsets. If the offsets are not far apart (target specific), it add MVT::Glue inputs and outputs to ensure they are scheduled together and in order. This optimization may benefit some targets by improving cache locality.</p>
